relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Instead of blocking the channel in the conventional manner of local anesthetics, it functions as a potent allosteric inhibitor.

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: This finding revealed that suzetrigine specifically binds to the second voltage-sensing domain of the channel.

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: The NAVIGATE-1 and NAVIGATE-2 trials showed that patients receiving VX-548 experienced a significantly greater reduction in pain intensity than the placebo groups for both the bunionectomy and abdominoplasty procedures.

relationships.subject: CYP3A
relationships.evidence_quote: The primary metabolic pathway for both compounds is via CYP3A, with excretion occurring through both fecal (49.9%) and urinary routes (44%), primarily as metabolites [14].

key_findings: Suzetrigine is an allosteric NaV1.8 inhibitor binding the KKGS motif in VSD2, with ~31,000-fold selectivity and no abuse potential in preclinical or clinical assessment.
NAVIGATE-1/2 showed greater pain reduction than placebo after bunionectomy and abdominoplasty; reduced creatinine clearance noted in diabetic neuropathy trial.
